- The primary relationship between the modifications is that they ensure the release of cached dentries only occurs when the filesystem is fully mounted. This change prevents potential issues that could arise from attempting to release dentries during mount failures, thereby improving the stability and correctness of the CIFS filesystem operations. The restructuring of the code maintains the original logic but adds a necessary condition to safeguard against premature dentry releases.
